pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: main hip 46 by 43 ft, near pyramid, NE and SE hips meet at about (583,505), short E-W ridge just E of centre; dark N face

pieces.name: front
pieces.notes: long S block, E-W ridge at about y 562 from the W hip end near x 407 running E into the main S slope; dark N face trapezoid from x 387 to 527

pieces.name: rear left
pieces.notes: small NW block beside the driveway notch, dark N triangle to a point near (530,438), lit face below; ridge taken N-S, could be a short E-W ridge instead

notes: main pyramid hip plus a long E-W front hip block on the SW and a small NW block; confidence medium-high; the S strip from y 638 to 665 inside the trace is a patio cover. Exclusions: dark flat strip with a white fascia line along the S side, reads as a rear patio cover or awning, not the main roof; lawn and shadow W of the front block W eave, the trace overshoots by about 4 ft
